name: Mysterious Ways
source:
Mysterious Ways draws you into a world where desire, memory, and dread intertwine beneath the surface.

Guided by an obsession he cannot escape, the protagonist stumbles into events that blur the line between reality, fantasy, and nightmare. What begins as a personal quest soon twists into something far deeper… and far darker.

This project blends visual novel storytelling with point-and-click exploration, wrapped in an atmosphere of mystery, lust, and the unknown.

[From [url=https://mysterious-ways.itch.io/mysterious-ways]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《神秘之路》将你带入一个欲望、记忆和恐惧在表面之下交织在一起的世界。

在无法摆脱的痴迷的引导下，主角陷入了模糊现实、幻想和噩梦之间界限的事件中。最初的个人追求很快就变得更深……也更黑暗。

该项目将视觉小说叙事与点击式探索融为一体，笼罩在神秘、欲望和未知的氛围中。

[来自[url=https://mysterious-ways.itch.io/mysterious-ways]Itch.io[/url]]
